heroTagline: building plugins, apps, bots, and other cool things
aboutP1: Hey, I'm Matthew, a developer from Tallinn, Estonia. I started with Minecraft modding, but eventually became interested in software engineering, system architecture, and building products from scratch. My main stack includes React, Kotlin, Rust, and Java, and I work on everything from game servers and Discord bots to AI applications and developer tools.
aboutP2: CachyOS is my daily driver, and I enjoy digging into how things work beneath the surface. I like building fast, reliable systems, experimenting with new technologies, and occasionally breaking things just to understand them better.
timelineStart: Started learning to code — Java basics, experimenting with everything
timelineMods: Got into Minecraft modding — built my first plugins, discovered what I actually enjoy
timelineBots: Built Discord bots, started learning Python and web scraping
timelineWeb: Switched to web dev — React, TypeScript, full-stack projects
timelineNow: Arch Linux daily driver, Rust, AI projects, building my own ecosystem
